purpose: The flip of CT50's proof stage: the manifest's fifth executed proof row, superseding card T00's frozen archive for CT50 -- the record that still held this case's stages -- without editing it (constraint 21). Every other stage row is carried from the manifest's own CT50 rows, which agree with that archive in status and observation count for all seventeen stages and differ only in the host_gate of task_reference_execution and c_emission, widened by later lanes; only proof moves, on the named workspace test this card landed. Proof 4 of 47 -> 5 of 47 is evidence about one case's artifact and never conformance (constraint 23).
derivation_rule: A stage is executed only where a named workspace test runs it on the case's own artifact. compiler/tests/ct50_proof_leg.rs include_str!s CT50's fixture, compiles it through compile_files, executes the checked task module's reference execution, derives the admitted causal order with the production observer (AdmittedCausalOrder::derive), asserts the events are the Lean referenceRun term event for event, recomputes the kernel-decided digest pin from those events with wrapping u64 arithmetic, runs the clause-for-clause transcription of dischargesLifetimeIdentity and requires acceptance, and enumerates the relation's admitted linearizations of the artifact's own order, requiring the admitted set to be the singleton {referenceRun}.

theorem_bound.primary: QCore.Ct50LifetimeIdentity.ct50_reference_run_discharges_the_lifetime_identity together with every_admitted_rendering_discharges_the_lifetime_identity, whose meaning is fixed by the seven theorems stated for an arbitrary accepted trace (discharged_each_generation_is_allocated_and_released_once, discharged_the_old_lifetime_closes_before_the_new_one_opens, discharged_no_fact_uses_the_old_capability, discharged_the_old_generation_is_never_read, discharged_the_one_read_names_the_new_generation, discharged_the_read_sits_inside_the_new_lifetime, discharged_every_fact_is_the_root_tasks)
theorem_bound.closure: an_admitted_rendering_is_the_reference_run: CT50's run has one actor, and the F02 relation demands agreement with the reference on EVERY actor's projection over the same multiset of facts, so the admitted set is a singleton. The closure is therefore the degenerate case of CT01's and CT37's -- proved here rather than assumed, and measured on the artifact by enumeration.
theorem_bound.pin: ct50_trace_digest = 1699395409980170611, proved by decide in Lean and recomputed from the artifact with wrapping u64 arithmetic; the Rust literal is itself compared with the Lean source's numeral by compiler/tests/proof_leg_digests.rs (PROOF-LEG-DIGESTS-UNCROSSCHECKED)
theorem_bound.alphabet: unchanged. CT50's run carries only allocated/dropped/read/completed events, all inside QCore.TaskTraceRelation's base alphabet; neither reference_trace nor the relation nor any existing digest moved.

proof.note: the artifact checked against the Lean-proved total decision procedure dischargesLifetimeIdentity (QCore.Ct50LifetimeIdentity, AuditCt50LifetimeIdentity.lean): each generation allocated once and released once, the old generation's whole existence closing before the new one begins, NO fact of the trace using the old generation, and the one read naming the new generation with the new allocation's own payload inside the new generation's lifetime. Reference-run discharge and admitted renderings covered -- the run is single-actor, so the relation admits nothing but the run itself (an_admitted_rendering_is_the_reference_run), proved in Lean and measured on the artifact by enumerating admitted_linearizations. Host-unconditional: no cfg, no Clang, no native half. SCOPE: the capability half of the scenario only; the numeric address reuse CT50 names is invisible to the F02 alphabet and stays with run_native_task_scenarios' observation, unproved.

non_vacuity_of_the_proof_leg.method: Two tiers, separated by measurement. TIER 1, the fixture mutations: each of three mutations of CT50's own case.qcore is measured at the place the pipeline catches it, so a mutation the CHECKER refuses is never presented as evidence about the leg. TIER 2, the rule mutations: each clause of the transcription and each Lean term is mutated in place and the named test watched go red, then restored and compared by sha256. Harness and log: docs/reports/ct-proof-leg-3/scripts/mutate_ct50_proof_leg.py and docs/reports/ct-proof-leg-3/mutations.log.
non_vacuity_of_the_proof_leg.clause_isolation: Four of the eight Lean-named mutants are proved to fail EXACTLY ONE clause, with every other clause still holding (overlapping_lifetimes_fail_only_the_old_lifetime_clause, an_escaping_stale_capability_fails_only_the_stale_use_clause, a_read_after_the_fresh_release_fails_only_the_read_window_clause, a_read_by_a_second_actor_fails_only_the_single_actor_clause), and the Rust test the_isolating_mutants_fail_only_their_named_clause re-measures the same isolation on the transcription. The two length-changing mutants are named as such rather than presented as isolating.

CT50.boundary: The binding is about the checked module's reference execution and the renderings the F02 relation admits against it, host-unconditionally. The emitted C's native behaviour stays observation-only under run_native_task_scenarios, and native_sanitized stays recorded_not_gated (a transcript in docs/reports/w6-reused-address/README.md, re-run by nothing). No verified extraction between Lean and Rust is claimed: the agreement is the checked-digest transcription pattern F02 established. MOST IMPORTANTLY: the numeric address reuse the scenario names -- the second mapping placed at the first one's address with MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE -- is invisible to the F02 alphabet, which carries generations and not addresses. The proved half is the capability half; the address half is native observation and is not proved (CT50-PROOF-ADDRESS-REUSE-UNPROVED).
